# SEG-Y fixture

segyio-small.sgy is Equinor's official synthetic, predictable SEG-Y test fixture, not a field survey.

Source: https://github.com/equinor/segyio/blob/ce7bf86e4bee75f3296a5a756fa123e981a04fea/test-data/small.sgy

Upstream reproduction and licensing: https://github.com/equinor/segyio

Retrieved 9 October 2026. It contains 25 traces, 50 samples per trace, inlines 1–5 and crosslines 20–24. No CRS or physical well-registration claim is attached.
